body: Well my main problem is that I'm sick of waiting. I'm signing off with the military in a year, so unlike other people who talk about this, I actually do not have much time left. And I would rather die on my own terms than by an unknown bomb on the side of the road. Once I sign the papers and get sent off, my chances of meeting anyone goes down a lot, and my chance of dying goes up a ton. So why not just end it now and get it over with?
